Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/main/Models/Box/glTF-Binary/Box.glb

Downloaded 2026-11-09. SHA-256:
ed52f7192b8311d700ac0ce80644e3852cd01537e4d62241b9acba023da3d54e

This small standard fixture is test-only, never shipped in a package. Tests read
its actual position accessor and compare the dual contour's corners, planes and
enclosed volume with that external reference. Other procedural SDF fixtures are
generated stand-ins, not published model reconstructions.
